title: Explore Pegasus Modules
description: Discover the powerful features built into Pegasus. Click on any module below to learn how it works and how you can set it up on your server.

automod.title: Auto-Moderation
automod.description: Automatically filter spam, bad words, and malicious content.
automod.fullDescription: Keep your server safe automatically with advanced filtering.
features: Filter bad words, links, and spam.
Automatically warn, mute, or kick offenders.
Customizable whitelist for specific roles and channels.
Detailed logs of all auto-mod actions.
automod.setup: Enable Auto-Moderation in the dashboard. Configure your word filters, spam thresholds, and select what punishments should be applied automatically. You can also specify channels to ignore.

economy.title: Economy System
economy.description: Virtual economy with shops, wallets, daily rewards, and betting.
economy.fullDescription: A rich virtual economy to boost server activity and engagement.
features: Daily rewards, working, and robbing commands.
Customizable shop with items that can grant roles or multipliers.
Leaderboards to see the wealthiest members.
economy.setup: Set your currency symbol and starting balance. Add items to your server shop, configure work/rob cooldowns, and let your members start earning!

engagement.title: Engagement
engagement.description: Reward active members, track messages and voice activity.
engagement.fullDescription: Track and reward member activity across your server.
features: Track messages sent and voice time.
Reward active members with economy coins.
engagement.setup: Enable engagement tracking and set how many coins should be awarded per message or per minute in voice chat.

giveaways.title: Giveaways
giveaways.description: Host giveaways with requirements, roles, and automated winners.
giveaways.fullDescription: Host interactive giveaways to reward your community.
features: Create, edit, and end giveaways easily.
giveaways.setup: You can start a giveaway directly from the dashboard or using the /giveaway command. Set the prize, duration, and number of winners.

jtc.title: Join to Create (JTC)
jtc.description: Dynamic temporary voice channels created when users join a hub.
jtc.fullDescription: Dynamic voice channels for a cleaner server layout.
features: Users join a hub channel to create their own temp channel.
Channel owner can rename, lock, or limit users.
Channels are automatically deleted when empty.
Keeps your server voice category neat.
jtc.setup: Select a 'Hub' voice channel in the dashboard. Whenever a user joins this channel, a temporary voice channel will be created for them.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.description: Essential commands to ban, kick, mute, and manage users.
moderation.fullDescription: Essential tools for your staff to manage the community.
features: Ban, kick, timeout, and warn commands.
moderation.setup: Configure your 'Moderator' roles and specify a log channel so your staff can keep track of all moderation actions taken.

schedule.title: Scheduled Events
schedule.description: Plan automated messages, reminders, and regular announcements.
schedule.fullDescription: Automate messages and reminders for your server.
schedule.setup: Create a new scheduled task in the dashboard. Write your message, choose the channel, and set the interval or exact time.

tickets.title: Tickets
tickets.description: Private support ticket channels, transcripts, and management.
tickets.fullDescription: Provide private 1-on-1 support for your members.
features: Customizable ticket panels with buttons or dropdowns.
Auto-saving transcripts sent to a log channel.
tickets.setup: Create a ticket panel in the dashboard, assign a support role, and send the panel to a channel. Members can click to open a private thread/channel.

warns.title: Warnings
warns.description: Track user infractions with automated punishments on threshold.
warns.fullDescription: A comprehensive strike system with automated punishments.
features: Keep track of user infractions permanently.
Allow users to check their own warns.
warns.setup: Define your punishment thresholds in the dashboard. When a moderator warns a user, the bot will check if they reached a threshold and act accordingly.

xp.title: Leveling & XP
xp.description: Award XP for chatting, custom role rewards, and leaderboards.
xp.fullDescription: Gamify your server by rewarding members with XP.
features: Role rewards for reaching specific levels.
xp.setup: Enable the leveling system. Configure the XP rate, set up role rewards, and customize the level up message channel.

custom-commands.title: Custom Commands
custom-commands.description: Create your own commands and auto-responses tailored to your server.
custom-commands.fullDescription: Add your own text commands to the bot.
features: Choose between slash commands or prefix commands.
custom-commands.setup: Click 'Add Command', choose a trigger name, and type the response. The bot will instantly learn the new command.

settings.title: Core Settings
settings.description: Manage prefix, language, logging, and general bot configuration.
settings.setup: Review these settings first to ensure the bot behaves exactly how you want it to on your server.
